narration.source: MEASURED — Modal L4, GitHub run 45825344446 (বিচারক narration chunk narration-film-01-r3-c1of2-r1), 26 Nov 2026
narration.basis: 54 voice units (batch 8, bf16, default attention) took 437.7 s of notebook time including model load: 8.1 s per unit, rounded up to 8.2. Units are now <= 200 characters (shorter than in that run), so this is conservative. decode_s 900 kept: the first Modal run spent ~915 s on image build, pip and model download before the clock; later runs reuse the cached weights. units_per_hour 1.94 is the Colab L4 rate (Colab CU accounting only; Modal is capped in dollars).

stills.source: MEASURED — Modal L40S, run of stills-film-01-r4-c1of2 (বিচারক film stills chunk 1), 27 Nov 2026
stills.basis: 39 stills (FLUX.1-schnell, 4 steps, guidance 0, 1344x768, enable_model_cpu_offload) took 519.9 s of notebook time including model load: 11.9 s per still including offload swaps, about 3.0 s per step at 4 steps. decode_s 900 and export_s 120 kept (the first run also paid image build, pip and weight download; later runs reuse the cached weights), so the forecast stays conservative. units_per_hour 1.94 is the Colab L4 rate (Colab CU accounting only; Modal is capped in dollars).

music.source: ESTIMATE — replace with measured values after the first run
music.basis: ACE-Step v1 3.5B, 60 inference steps per cue (music_cell infer_step=60), up to 240 s cues on L4: no measured run in this repo. 3 s/step (180 s per cue) is a conservative allowance. decode_s covers pip install from git, weight download, hashing and load.

reel_clips.basis: Profile l4-balanced-v2 (512x896, 121 frames, 24 fps = 5.041667 s per clip, 24 steps, guidance 5). Since R20 the reel_clips forecast is clip_s x shots x 1.15 margin: clip_s 500 s is the measured end-to-end time per finished clip, rounded up from the slowest observation (476.34, 479.08, 484.71, 490.90, 495.04, 499.95 s). One batch holds at most 5 shots so it fits one Wan job's 2700 s wall. s_per_step 31.0, decode_s 180 and export_s 120 are the earlier step-based inputs, kept for the record and no longer used for reel_clips. takes 1: the wan22 batch contract allows one start per shot. units_per_hour 1.94 is the observed L4 session rate.
